subject: Kan niet inloggen
reason: The ticket is a standard forgotten password request fully covered by F01. As a how-to question where the help centre solves the problem, it is classified as category question and priority P4.
draft_reply:
Hoi Marloes,

Je kunt een nieuw wachtwoord instellen door naar app.roosterly.nl/login te gaan en te klikken op "Wachtwoord vergeten". Vul hier je e-mailadres in. Je ontvangt dan een resetlink die 60 minuten geldig is. Zie je binnen 10 minuten geen e-mail? Controleer dan even je spambox.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Team Roosterly
reply_en:
Hi Marloes,

You can reset your password by going to app.roosterly.nl/login and clicking "Wachtwoord vergeten" (Forgot password). Enter your email address there. You will receive a reset link that is valid for 60 minutes. If you don't see an email within 10 minutes, please check your spam folder.

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
verified_en: Hi Marloes, You can set a new password by going to app.roosterly.nl/login and clicking on "Wachtwoord vergeten". Enter your email address here. You will then receive a reset link that is valid for 60 minutes. Do you not see an email within 10 minutes? Then check your spam folder. Kind regards, Team Roosterly

subject: Nieuwe medewerker
reason: This is a standard how-to question fully answered by FAQ F02. Priority is P4 as it is a general how-to request.

Hallo Anouk,

Je kunt een nieuwe medewerker toevoegen door als manager te gaan naar Team → Medewerker toevoegen. Vul daar de naam, het e-mailadres en de contracturen in en klik op Uitnodigen. De medewerker ontvangt dan een e-mail om de app te installeren.

subject: Export naar Loket
reason: This is a standard how-to/information question about payroll integration covered by F04 and F05. The customer is on the Basis plan, so the reply mentions that Plus is required.
draft_reply:
Hallo,

Ja, Roosterly kan goedgekeurde uren exporteren naar Loket.nl. Deze koppeling maakt onderdeel uit van het Plus-abonnement.

Je kunt dit instellen onder Instellingen → Koppelingen → Salaris (Settings → Integrations → Payroll). Als je momenteel een Basis-abonnement hebt, kun je op elk moment upgraden via Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription).

Met vriendelijke groet,
Team Roosterly
reply_en:
Hello,

Yes, Roosterly can export approved hours to Loket.nl. This integration is part of the Plus plan.

You can set this up under Instellingen → Koppelingen → Salaris (Settings → Integrations → Payroll). If you are currently on a Basis plan, you can upgrade at any time under Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription).

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
verified_en: Hello, Yes, Roosterly can export approved hours to Loket.nl. This integration is part of the Plus plan. You can set this up under Instellingen → Koppelingen → Salaris (Settings → Integrations → Payroll). If you currently have a Basis plan, you can upgrade at any time under Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription). Kind regards, Team Roosterly

subject: Schichten tauschen
reason: This is a standard how-to question about swapping shifts fully answered by F03. Priority is P4.
draft_reply:
Hallo,

Ihre Mitarbeiter können in der App auf eine Schicht tippen und auf "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap) tippen. Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit der gleichen Rolle können den Tausch annehmen. Standardmäßig muss die Führungskraft den Tausch unter Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests) genehmigen. Sie können diese Genehmigung unter Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota) ausschalten.

Viele Grüße
Team Roosterly
reply_en:
Hello,

Employees open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. By default, the manager approves it under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). You can turn this approval off under Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota).

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
verified_en: Hello, Your employees can tap on a shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. By default, the manager must approve the swap under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). You can turn off this approval under Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota). Best regards, Team Roosterly

Met vriendelijke groet,
Team Roosterly

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
verified_en: Hello, You can add a second location via Settings -> Locations -> New location (Instellingen -> Vestigingen -> Nieuwe vestiging). Because you have a Plus subscription, multiple locations are included and you can link employees to multiple locations. Kind regards, Team Roosterly
